title: Composer 2 Released
description: Cursor released Composer 2 with advanced programming performance capabilities. Additionally added over 30 new partner plugins (Atlassian, Datadog, GitLab, Glean, Hugging Face, monday.com, PlanetScale), Automations for building resident agents, JetBrains IDE support via ACP, and various editor improvements including Bugbot Autofix and AI Code Review.

community_feedback.quote: Composer 2 is just Kimi K2.5 with RL - rushes through everything without any apparent reasoning or planning, it just tries to execute as quickly
Composer 2 is usable - working well with medium level styling issues, complex handling of some APIs
86% cost reduction compared to Composer 1.5 at $0.50/M input pricing

title: Persistent Agent Threads for Pro and Max Plans
description: Claude released a persistent agent thread feature for Pro and Max plans to manage tasks in Cowork from mobile and desktop, enabling enhanced cross-platform task management capabilities.

community_feedback.quote: Claude Code is being used for ticket triage - it reads tickets, digs into the codebase, and leaves comments with suggestions

title: Progressive Web App Launch and Price Reduction
description: Devin can now be installed as a Progressive Web App on both desktop and mobile devices through Chrome or Edge browsers. Additionally, Devin 2.0 features a significant price reduction from $500/month to $20/month, making autonomous AI software engineering more accessible.

title: GPT-5.4 Mini Model Support
description: Windsurf added support for GPT-5.4 Mini, available at 1x credits with promotional pricing. Also includes multiple bug fixes and performance improvements including Mac x64 build fixes and Apple M5 support.

community_feedback.quote: I was horrified after the new GPT-5.4 system destroyed my credits in just a few queries with no warning
GPT 5.4 works well for me in Windsurf

title: Bug Fixes and Performance Improvements
description: Various bug fixes and performance improvements across Cascade, MCP, and stability components.

title: GPT-5.4 Model Integration
description: Windsurf integrated GPT-5.4 with promotional pricing across different reasoning efforts: No Reasoning (1x credits), Low Reasoning (1x), Medium Reasoning (2x), High Reasoning (3x), and Extra High Reasoning (8x).

community_feedback.quote: GPT 5.4 is much better at not duplicating code unnecessarily

title: Codex CLI v0.114.0
description: Released Codex CLI version 0.114.0 with experimental code mode for more isolated coding workflows and a new hooks engine.

title: v0.32.0 - Generalist Agent and Model Steering
description: Released v0.32.0 with Generalist Agent enabled for improved task delegation and routing, plus Model Steering in Workspace features. Also includes customizable UI elements with new /footer command and standardized semantic focus colors.
